verses.en: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;
verses.pt: Ora, digo que por todo o tempo em que o herdeiro é menino, em nada difere de um servo, ainda que seja senhor de tudo;
verses.en_web: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all;
verses.en_bbe: But I say that as long as the son is a child, he is in no way different from a servant, though he is lord of all;

verses.en: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.
verses.pt: mas está debaixo de tutores e curadores até o tempo determinado pelo pai.
verses.en_web: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.
verses.en_bbe: But is under keepers and managers till the time fixed by the father.

verses.en: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:
verses.pt: Assim também nós, quando éramos meninos, estávamos reduzidos à servidão debaixo dos rudimentos do mundo;
verses.en_web: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.
verses.en_bbe: So we, when we were young, were kept under the first rules of the world;

verses.en: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
verses.pt: mas, vindo a plenitude dos tempos, Deus enviou seu Filho, nascido de mulher, nascido debaixo de lei,
verses.en_web: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,
verses.en_bbe: But when the time had come, God sent out his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

verses.en: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
verses.pt: para resgatar os que estavam debaixo de lei, a fim de recebermos a adoção de filhos.
verses.en_web: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of children.
verses.en_bbe: That he might make them free who were under the law, and that we might be given the place of sons.

verses.en: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
verses.pt: E, porque sois filhos, Deus enviou aos nossos corações o Espírito de seu Filho, que clama: Aba, Pai.
verses.en_web: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”
verses.en_bbe: And because you are sons, God has sent out the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, saying, Abba, Father.

verses.en: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
verses.pt: Portanto já não és mais servo, mas filho; e se és filho, és também herdeiro por Deus.
verses.en_web: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
verses.en_bbe: So that you are no longer a servant, but a son; and if a son, then the heritage of God is yours.

verses.en: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.
verses.pt: Outrora, quando não conhecíeis a Deus, servíeis aos que por natureza não são deuses;
verses.en_web: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.
verses.en_bbe: But at that time, having no knowledge of God, you were servants to those who by right are no gods:

verses.en: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?
verses.pt: agora, porém, que já conheceis a Deus, ou, melhor, sendo conhecidos por Deus, como tornais outra vez a esses rudimentos fracos e pobres, aos quais de novo quereis servir?
verses.en_web: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?
verses.en_bbe: But now that you have come to have knowledge of God, or more truly, God has knowledge of you, how is it that you go back again to the poor and feeble first things, desiring to be servants to them again?

verses.en: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.
verses.pt: Guardais dias, e meses, e tempos, e anos.
verses.en_web: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.
verses.en_bbe: You keep days, and months, and fixed times, and years.

verses.en: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.
verses.pt: Temo a vosso respeito não haja eu trabalhado em vão entre vós.
verses.en_web: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.
verses.en_bbe: I am in fear of you, that I may have been working for you to no purpose.

verses.en: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.
verses.pt: Irmãos, rogo-vos que vos torneis como eu, porque também eu me tornei como vós. Nenhum mal me fizestes;
verses.en_web: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,
verses.en_bbe: My desire for you, brothers, is that you may be as I am, because I am as you are. You have done me no wrong;

verses.en: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.
verses.pt: e vós sabeis que por causa de uma enfermidade da carne vos anunciei o evangelho a primeira vez,
verses.en_web: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.
verses.en_bbe: But you have knowledge that with a feeble body I was preaching the good news to you the first time;

verses.en: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
verses.pt: e aquilo que na minha carne era para vós uma tentação, não o desprezastes nem o repelistes, antes me recebestes como a um anjo de Deus, mesmo como a Cristo Jesus.
verses.en_web: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: And you did not have a poor opinion of me because of the trouble in my flesh, or put shame on it; but you took me to your hearts as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

verses.en: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
verses.pt: Onde está, pois, aquela vossa satisfação? Porque vos dou testemunho de que, se possível fora, teríeis arrancado os vossos olhos, e mos teríeis dado.
verses.en_web: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.
verses.en_bbe: Where then is that happy condition of yours? because I give you witness, that, if possible, you would have taken out your eyes and given them to me.

verses.en: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?
verses.pt: Tornei-me acaso vosso inimigo, porque vos disse a verdade?
verses.en_web: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?
verses.en_bbe: So then am I no longer your friend, because I give you true words?

verses.en: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.
verses.pt: Eles vos procuram zelosamente não com bons motivos, mas querem vos excluir, para que zelosamente os procureis a eles.
verses.en_web: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.
verses.en_bbe: Their interest in you is not good; but their desire is that you may be shut out, so that you may go after them.

verses.en: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.
verses.pt: No que é bom, é bom serdes sempre procurados, e não só quando estou presente convosco.
verses.en_web: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.
verses.en_bbe: But it is good to have an interest in a good cause at all times, and not only when I am present with you.

verses.en: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,
verses.pt: Meus filhinhos, por quem de novo sinto as dores de parto, até que Cristo seja formado em vós;
verses.en_web: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—
verses.en_bbe: My children, of whom I am again in birth-pains till Christ is formed in you,

verses.en: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.
verses.pt: eu bem quisera estar presente convosco agora, e mudar o tom da minha voz; porque estou perplexo a vosso respeito.
verses.en_web: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.
verses.en_bbe: Truly my desire is to be present with you now, using a changed voice; for I am troubled about you.

verses.en: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
verses.pt: Dizei-me, os que quereis estar debaixo da lei, não ouvis vós a lei?
verses.en_web: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?
verses.en_bbe: Say, you whose desire it is to be under the law, do you not give ear to the law?

verses.en: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.
verses.pt: Porque está escrito que Abraão teve dois filhos, um da escrava, e outro da livre.
verses.en_web: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.
verses.en_bbe: Because it is in the Writings, that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant-woman, and one by the free woman.

verses.en: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.
verses.pt: Todavia o que era da escrava nasceu segundo a carne, mas, o que era da livre, por promessa.
verses.en_web: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.
verses.en_bbe: Now the son by the servant-woman has his birth after the flesh; but the son by the free woman has his birth through the undertaking of God.

verses.en: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.
verses.pt: O que se entende por alegoria: pois essas mulheres são dois pactos; um do monte Sinai, que dá à luz filhos para a servidão, e que é Agar.
verses.en_web: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.
verses.en_bbe: Which things have a secret sense; because these women are the two agreements; one from the mountain of Sinai, giving birth to servants, which is Hagar.

verses.en: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.
verses.pt: Ora, esta Agar é o monte Sinai na Arábia e corresponde à Jerusalém atual, pois é escrava com seus filhos.
verses.en_web: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.
verses.en_bbe: Now this Hagar is the mountain Sinai in Arabia, and is the image of the Jerusalem which now is: which is a servant with her children.

verses.en: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
verses.pt: Mas a Jerusalém que é de cima é livre; a qual é nossa mãe.
verses.en_web: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
verses.en_bbe: But the Jerusalem on high is free, which is our mother.

verses.en: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.
verses.pt: Pois está escrito: Alegra-te, estéril, que não dás à luz; esforça-te e clama, tu que não estás de parto; porque mais são os filhos da desolada do que os da que tem marido.
verses.en_web: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you that don’t travail. For more are the children of the desolate than of her who has a husband.”
verses.en_bbe: For it is in the Writings, You who have never given birth, be glad; give cries of joy, you who have had no birth-pains; for the children of her who has been given up by her husband are more than those of the woman who has a husband.

verses.en: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
verses.pt: Ora vós, irmãos, sois filhos da promessa, como Isaque.
verses.en_web: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.
verses.en_bbe: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are the children of the undertaking of God.

verses.en: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.
verses.pt: Mas, como naquele tempo o que nasceu segundo a carne perseguia ao que nasceu segundo o Espírito, assim é também agora.
verses.en_web: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.
verses.en_bbe: But as in those days he who had birth after the flesh was cruel to him who had birth after the Spirit, even so it is now.

verses.en: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the free woman.
verses.pt: Que diz, porém, a Escritura? Lança fora a escrava e seu filho, porque de modo algum o filho da escrava herdará com o filho da livre.
verses.en_web: However what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman.”
verses.en_bbe: What then do the Writings say? Send away the servant-woman and her son; for the son of the servant-woman will not have a part in the heritage with the son of the free woman.

verses.en: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
verses.pt: Pelo que, irmãos, não somos filhos da escrava, mas da livre.
verses.en_web: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.
verses.en_bbe: So, brothers, we are not children of the servant-woman, but of the free woman.
